backgrounds: This episode is a fast-cut 'Then vs Now' relationship montage, not a single set. It jumps between several distinct high-detail 3D-animated locations: a golden-hour two-lane country road with utility poles, hedgerows and rolling hills (used for a title-card walk/run shot); the interior of an old sedan driving at sunset; a poolside patio at dusk with lounge chairs, string lights and a wooden fence, plus an underwater shot inside the swimming pool; a smoky, dimly lit nightclub/bar with neon signage and colored stage lighting where a crowd dances; the couple sitting on the roof of their parked car under a clear starry night sky in open countryside; and a bright, plain white/cream kitchen (cabinets, window, dish rack) for a domestic 'inside joke' beat. Title and end-card frames use a flat solid black backdrop with centered text/logo. The environments are polished, film-quality CG sets rather than a recurring stylized single-room set.

lighting_notes: Lighting shifts scene to scene to match mood/time-of-day: warm golden-hour backlight and lens flare on the road and jumping/car scenes; cool aqua underwater lighting in the pool; moody low-key nightclub lighting with red, blue and teal neon accents and stage spotlights; deep navy starlit night lighting for the car-roof scene; soft, even, bright daylight through a window for the kitchen scene. The contrast between warm nostalgic tones (road, night sky) and saturated club neon suggests deliberate lighting-as-mood-signal for each vignette.

visual_complexity_notes: The backgrounds are dense, cinematic, feature-film-quality CG environments (not a minimal flat set) with real depth, atmospheric lighting and crowd/background characters in several shots (club, poolside party). This visual richness appears deliberate, borrowed from a big-budget animated film aesthetic, to sell the 'Then vs Now' montage as a mini emotional highlight reel rather than a static skit set. The vertical crop with thick black letterboxing top and bottom, plus large bold yellow title cards, imposes a simple graphic layer on top of the busy backgrounds to keep the social-media framing and text legible.
